name: services/groups/group
description: Get information on a given group.
brief_description: Get information on a given group.

arguments.name: group_number
arguments.description: Group number unique with regard to the course unit.

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Pipe-separated list of informational fields/sections you're interested in. This must be any subset of keys, which are described in the returns section.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

result_fields.name: course_unit_id
result_fields.description: ID of the course unit related to the group,

result_fields.name: group_number
result_fields.description: number of the group unique with regard to the course unit,

result_fields.name: class_type
result_fields.description: a LangDict object identyfing class type,

result_fields.name: class_type_id
result_fields.description: class type id,

result_fields.name: group_url
result_fields.description: group homepage URL (or null if none),

result_fields.name: course_id
result_fields.description: course ID,

result_fields.name: course_name
result_fields.description: a LangDict object with the courses name,

result_fields.name: course_homepage_url
result_fields.description: courses homepage URL (or null if none),

result_fields.name: course_profile_url
result_fields.description: courses profile URL,

result_fields.name: course_is_currently_conducted
result_fields.description:
boolean, indicates if the course
	is conducted in one of active academic terms,

result_fields.name: course_fac_id
result_fields.description: ID of a faculty which runs this course.

result_fields.name: course_lang_id
result_fields.description:
ID of a language in which the course is conducted, or null
	if language is unknown.

result_fields.name: term_id
result_fields.description: ID of academic term to which this group is related.

result_fields.name: lecturers
participants
result_fields.description:
an array of dictionaries describing participants of this group; each dictionary contains fields from primary section in services/users/user method.
Additional permissions note: Access Token with the 'studies' scope required (or administrative access). Note that only lecturer or participant can ask for group participants.
